The subject property is cuirently improved with a partial one story and partial three-story,
mixed-use building with 4 dwelling units at the front ofthe property and a residential
building with one dwelling unit at the rear of the property. The Applicant proposes to
build an upper stoiy addition over the one-story portion of the front building and establish
3 new dwelling units within the proposed addition for a total of 7 dwelling units at the
property. The rear building will be demolished and replaced with 5 parking spaces. The
Applicant needs a zoning change in order to comply with the minimum lot area per
dwelling unit and the maximum floor area requirements ofthe Ordinance.
